req.title: Delete cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall expire cookies named in the query string of GET /cookies/delete and redirect to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The delete_cookies handler at GET /cookies/delete reads cookie names from the query string, calls r.delete_cookie(key=key) for each, and returns a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path – named cookie is expired via Set-Cookie with a past date and a 302 redirect is issued; (2) negative path – no query params yields a 302 with no Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary – deleting exactly one vs. multiple cookies; (4) state transition – cookie present before delete is absent after following the redirect; (5) decision table – value portion of query param is irrelevant to deletion. Mutation resilience requires exact status code assertions (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value (/cookies), exact Set-Cookie expiry semantics (expires in the past), and both sides of the cookie-present/absent condition.

tests.name: test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie
preconditions: A cookie named 'session' is set on the client
expected: Set-Cookie header for 'session' contains an expiry in the past (expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: system shall expire cookies named in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie():
    # First set the cookie
    r_set = client.get('/cookies/set/session/abc')
    assert r_set.status_code == 302

    # Now delete it without following redirect
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?session=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

    # Verify Set-Cookie header expires the cookie
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) >= 1
    matched = any('session' in h and ('1970' in h or 'expires' in h.lower()) for h in set_cookie_headers)
    assert matched, f'Expected expired Set-Cookie for session, got: {set_cookie_headers}'

test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie()

tests.name: test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_response
expected: Exactly two Set-Cookie headers are present, one for 'alpha' and one for 'beta', both with past expiry
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: all cookies named in query string shall be expired
BVA: boundary between one cookie (n=1) and two cookies (n=2)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_response():
    client.get('/cookies/set/alpha/1')
    client.get('/cookies/set/beta/2')

    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?alpha=&beta=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2, f'Expected 2 Set-Cookie headers, got {len(set_cookie_headers)}: {set_cookie_headers}'

    names_expired = [h.split('=')[0].strip() for h in set_cookie_headers]
    assert 'alpha' in names_expired, f'alpha not in {names_expired}'
    assert 'beta' in names_expired, f'beta not in {names_expired}'

    for h in set_cookie_headers:
        assert '1970' in h or 'expires' in h.lower(), f'Cookie not expired: {h}'

test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_response()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect
actions: Set cookie token=xyz via /cookies/set/token/xyz following redirect
Verify cookie is present via GET /cookies
GET /cookies to verify cookie is absent
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: state transition from cookie-present to cookie-absent after delete
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect():
    # Set the cookie
    client.get('/cookies/set/token/xyz', follow_redirects=True)

    # Verify it is present
    r_before = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r_before.status_code == 200
    data_before = json.loads(r_before.data)
    assert data_before['cookies'].get('token') == 'xyz', f'Expected token=xyz, got {data_before}'

    # Delete the cookie (follow redirect so client jar is updated)
    r_del = client.get('/cookies/delete?token=', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r_del.status_code == 200

    # Verify it is absent
    r_after = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    data_after = json.loads(r_after.data)
    assert 'token' not in data_after['cookies'], f'Expected token absent, got {data_after}'
    assert data_after['cookies'] == {}, f'Expected empty cookies, got {data_after["cookies"]}'

test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_value_in_query_string_is_irrelevant():
    client.get('/cookies/set/pref/dark')

    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?pref=anything_here', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) >= 1, f'Expected at least 1 Set-Cookie, got: {set_cookie_headers}'
    matched = any('pref' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    assert matched, f'Expected Set-Cookie for pref, got: {set_cookie_headers}'
    for h in set_cookie_headers:
        if 'pref' in h:
            assert '1970' in h or 'expires' in h.lower(), f'pref cookie not expired: {h}'

preconditions: Cookie 'ghost' does not exist in the client jar
actions: GET /cookies/delete?ghost= without following redirect (cookie was never set)
expected: A Set-Cookie header for 'ghost' is still emitted (delete_cookie is called regardless)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: delete is attempted for all query-string names regardless of whether cookie exists
NEG: negative path where named cookie does not exist in client

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_nonexistent_cookie_still_returns_302():
    # Do NOT set 'ghost' cookie first
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?ghost=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

    # Flask's delete_cookie still emits a Set-Cookie with past expiry
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) >= 1, f'Expected Set-Cookie even for nonexistent cookie, got: {set_cookie_headers}'
    matched = any('ghost' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    assert matched, f'Expected Set-Cookie for ghost, got: {set_cookie_headers}'

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies_not_other_path
actions: Inspect Location header character by character
expected: Location header equals exactly '/cookies' (not '/cookie', not '/cookies/', not '/cookies/delete')
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: redirect target must be /cookies exactly
BVA: boundary between correct path string and off-by-one string mutations
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies_not_other_path():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?x=1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location == '/cookies', f'Expected /cookies, got {repr(location)}'
    assert location != '/cookies/', f'Trailing slash must not be present'
    assert location != '/cookies/delete', f'Must not redirect back to delete'
    assert location != '/cookie', f'Must not be singular /cookie'
    assert len(location) == len('/cookies'), f'Exact length must be {len("/cookies")}, got {len(location)}'

test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies_not_other_path()
